name: cache
description: Configures caching services by installing Memcached, setting up Redis with authentication, creating a log directory, and applying a custom Ruby‑block hack to clean up Redis configuration defaults.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI tutorial application by installing Python, cloning the source repository, setting up a virtual environment, installing dependencies, provisioning PostgreSQL with database and user, creating an .env file, and configuring a systemd service.

name: nginx-multisite
description: Sets up Nginx with multiple SSL‑enabled sub‑domains, hardens the host with fail2ban, UFW, and SSH configuration, generates self‑signed certificates for development, and deploys per‑site document roots and static index pages.
